title: Chapter 208 Sword Emperor Duan Hen
content:
Chapter 208 Sword Emperor Duan Hen

Immediately, the two walked slowly towards Lu Xue and the others with heavy steps.

"Miss Lu, it was me who lost."

Looking at Lu Xue, Xiao Chen sighed in his heart and bowed.

Xiao Xuanmu, who was beside him, also bowed, but did not say anything.

Seeing this, Lu Xue smiled and said, "It's lucky, luck."

"Then our bet?"

Hearing this, Xiao Chen and the others looked at each other.

"Miss Lu, I am willing to accept the loss. Logically speaking, my Xiao clan wants to join the deserted city, but now my Xiao clan is still in danger and even the disaster of extermination is caused.

Xiao Chen smiled bitterly.

Lu Xue quickly understood the meaning of this sentence.

"Don't worry, the purpose of my visit this time is to help you solve the problem."

As soon as these words were spoken, Xiao Chen and the others also smiled.

At the beginning, the two of them didn't believe in Lu Xue's ability, but now they have changed their views on Lu Xue.

I can only say that they are worthy of being the daughters of those two.

"Miss Lu, I'll take you to my Xiao clan now."

Then Xiao Chen and the others stopped talking and took Lu Xue and Ao Qing directly to the location of their Xiao clan in the Immortal Realm.

But shortly after the three of them left, a figure suddenly appeared here.

"Hmm? Are you leaving?"

A man holding a sword looked around with a serious expression. Apart from the broken barrier of the fairy world and the turbulent turbulence in the void that was cut and surging, the field was already empty.

The man holding the sword was Duan Hen who worked with the powerful people in the Immortal Realm not long ago to block the shocking sword light.

The strongest sword cultivator in the bright side of the Immortal Realm is known as the Sword Emperor.

He became the name of the Sword Saint at 100,000 years old and swept the younger generation of the Immortal Realm.

Then it took millions of years to understand the sword art, and to use the body as the sword, and finally become the sword emperor!

It is no exaggeration to say that Duan Hen is the leader of the swordsmanship in the entire fairy world.

But now, a strange sword cultivator appeared. Duan Hen, as a top sword cultivator, knew very well the gap between him and the other party.

It was just that sword, and I was not sure that one person could take it.

Standing there, Duan Hen looked in the direction of the Wood Immortal Realm for a long time, and finally made a major decision.

"I haven't been to the Wood Fairy Realm for a long time."

Duan Hen murmured to himself, then slowly walked towards the direction of the Wood Fairy Realm.

Buzz —

I saw that when Duan Hen stepped into the Wood Immortal Realm with one foot, a buzzing sound came from the entire Wood Immortal Realm.

At this moment, all the powerful Immortal Emperor Realm in the entire Wood Fairy Realm raised their heads and looked towards the direction of the Immortal Realm.

"The strong man in the Immortal Realm?!"

"It's impossible, the strong people in the Immortal Realm will come here."

The strong men were both frightened and confused.

It has been a long time since the strong man from the Immortal Realm has arrived.

Because the Wood Fairy Realm is the weakest among the five great immortal worlds. In each era, a large amount of fresh blood will appear injected from the five great immortal worlds. In each era, the strong people in the Wood Fairy Realm are almost the least and the weakest.

Over time, the Wood Fairy Realm has become a laughing stock in the Fairy Realm.

In the fairyland, the status of the strong men in the Wood Fairyland is almost the lowest, so the people in the Wood Fairyland will be confused about the arrival of the strong men in the fairyland.

Did they discover something?

And at this time, at the boundary of the Wood Immortal Realm.

Duan Hen stood on the land of the Wood Fairy Realm for the first time, and his whole body felt inexplicably uncomfortable.

"Is this the Wood Immortal Realm? It's really weak."

Duan Hen shook his head and became a little suspicious of his guess.

Can such a strong man really appear in this kind of place?

Maybe it's really just an accident.

Standing there, Duan Hen was silent for a moment, then headed towards the depths of the Wood Immortal Realm.

Since you are here, let's take a look.

Duan Hen's aura was not deliberately concealed, and many top powers in the Wood Immortal Realm clearly felt Duan Hen's existence.

But they did not act rashly.

Because they didn't know the purpose of such powerful people from the fairyland coming here.

What's more, this strong man is at the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm and is also a sword cultivator.

Who doesn’t know that Jian Cultivator has a bad temper?

They dare not provoke it.

In this way, Duan Hen wandered in the Wood Immortal Realm for a long time and finally came to a giant city.

The city gate is large and looks extremely magnificent.

On it, there are two big characters engraved - Huangcheng.

"Wild City?"

Duan Hen did not see any two eyes in the Wood Immortal Realm, and only this giant city aroused his interest.

Because, he found that he couldn't see through this place.

"You are not a local, right?"

At this time, a sound suddenly came from the city wall.

Duan Hen looked up and saw a man holding a sword leaning on the pillar of the city wall looking at him calmly.

Suddenly, Duan Hen was slightly stunned.

"interesting."

call out!

Duan Hen came directly to the city wall and stood in front of the man holding the sword.

"The sword is good."

Duan Hen smiled.

Hearing this, the man holding the sword smiled back.

"Excessive award."

"How do you know I'm not a local?"

At this time, Duan Hen suddenly said.

I did nothing.

The man holding the sword in front of him was nothing but the first line of defense in Huangcheng, Huangshou.

Huang Shou looked at Duan Hen and said, "It's very simple, because I saw a surprise in your eyes."

"It's probably the first time you know about the deserted city."

Duan Hen nodded.

"It seems that your wasteland city is very famous in the Wood Fairy World."

Hearing this, Huang Shou smiled without saying a word.

At this time, Duan Hen continued, "Are you interested in worshiping me as your teacher?"

Huang Shou shook his head.

"Why?"

"Do you know who I am?"

Duan Hen was a little surprised to see Huang Shou rejecting him.

He believed that the man in front of him was definitely aware of his strength, and since he knew why he refused him.

Could it be?

I saw Huang Shou saying, "This is not as simple as you seem."

"Also, I have my own path."

These words made Duan Hen frown slightly.

He turned around and looked into the deserted city, frowning deeper.

Because he found that this deserted city was much weaker than he thought. Although there were many people, they were basically some miscellaneous fish.

Duan Hen's eyes slightly condensed and he looked at it again.

This time, he saw a lot more deeply.

Duan Hen's eyes also attracted some of the attention of existence.

Buzz —

The next moment, a figure appeared in front of Duan Hen.

"Who are you?"

The visitor is the agent of the current deserted city, Anfeng.

Seeing Anfeng, Huang Shou nodded slightly to Anfeng.

Duan Hen smiled.

"You should be the Lord of the Huangcheng City."

In the entire wasteland city, what he saw was that Wan Feng had the highest cultivation level and could barely catch his eye.

More importantly, he could see that Wan Feng was like this because his cultivation level had regressed.

"My name is Duan Hen, I don't know if you have heard of it."

"No."

Wan Feng said expressionlessly.
